info.name: Vanex S3 - OTA Check and Download - 2026-10-22
info.description: Existing device OTA protocol. No API Key or login token. Device-Id must be the actual MAC, not IMEI/cabGuid. Use the real installed version: POST updates server-side reported version/connection time. These requests do not push an upgrade to a remote device. Download tickets and returned connection credentials are sensitive. Clear runtime variables before sharing.

request.description: Returns a text health message. It does not select firmware.

exec: if (!/^([0-9a-fA-F]{2}:){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}$/.test(mac)) throw new Error('Set deviceMac to the actual colon-separated MAC, not IMEI or cabGuid.');

if (!/^[0-9]{1,9}(\.[0-9]{1,9}){0,3}(-[0-9A-Za-z]+([.-][0-9A-Za-z]+)*)?(\+[0-9A-Za-z]+([.-][0-9A-Za-z]+)*)?$/.test(version)) throw new Error('Set currentVersion to the real installed firmware version.');
if (pm.variables.get('boardType') !== 'jiuchuan-s3') throw new Error('This collection is for the jiuchuan-s3 board.');
if (!['https://robot.suji.work/xiaozhi','http://47.94.91.32:8002/xiaozhi'].includes(pm.variables.get('otaBaseUrl'))) throw new Error('Unexpected OTA origin.');
if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error('OTA HTTP error; do not download.');
if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) throw new Error('Invalid OTA response.');
if (body.error || (body.code !== undefined && Number(body.code) !== 0)) throw new Error(body.error || body.msg || 'OTA server error');
if (!body.websocket && !body.mqtt && !body.activation) throw new Error('Missing device configuration.');
if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[0-9]{1,9}(\.[0-9]{1,9}){0,3}(-[0-9A-Za-z]+([.-][0-9A-Za-z]+)*)?(\+[0-9A-Za-z]+([.-][0-9A-Za-z]+)*)?$/.test(value)) throw new Error('Invalid firmware version.');
for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(installed.length, target.length); i++) {
if (comparison <= 0) throw new Error('Returned URL is not for a newer numeric version; inspect before downloading.');
if (!new RegExp('^https://robot[.]suji[.]work/xiaozhi/otaMag/download/[0-9a-f-]+$', 'i').test(firmware.url)) throw new Error('Unexpected download URL.');

request.description: No Client-Id is required for this diagnostic request. The endpoint is not read-only: it updates reported firmware version and last connection time. This does not remotely start a firmware installation.

exec: if (!new RegExp('^https://robot[.]suji[.]work/xiaozhi/otaMag/download/[0-9a-f-]+$', 'i').test(pm.variables.get('otaDownloadUrl') || '')) throw new Error('Run the OTA check first and obtain a valid update URL.');

if (pm.response.code !== 206 || !match || Number(match[1]) <= 65536 || Number(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Length')) !== 65536 || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(hash) || etag !== '"' + hash + '"') throw new Error('Range response identity/length mismatch.');

request.description: Checks the first chunk and saves the ETag, total size and next offset. This response alone is not a complete firmware image.

exec: if (!new RegExp('^https://robot[.]suji[.]work/xiaozhi/otaMag/download/[0-9a-f-]+$', 'i').test(pm.variables.get('otaDownloadUrl') || '')) throw new Error('Missing valid OTA URL.');
if (pm.variables.get('otaResumeOffset') !== '65536' || !/^"[0-9a-f]{64}"$/.test(pm.variables.get('otaETag') || '')) throw new Error('Run the first-chunk request successfully before resuming.');
if (pm.response.code === 200) throw new Error('Server returned a full image: restart from byte 0, never append this response.');

if (pm.response.code !== 206 || pm.response.headers.get('Content-Range') !== 'bytes ' + offset + '-' + (total - 1) + '/' + total || Number(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Length')) !== total - offset || pm.response.headers.get('ETag') !== pm.variables.get('otaETag') || pm.response.headers.get('X-Firmware-SHA256') !== pm.variables.get('otaSha256')) throw new Error('Resume range or firmware identity mismatch.');

request.description: Downloads only the remaining bytes. Postman does not merge this with the first chunk. Use the full-download request for a standalone app file.

exec: if (!new RegExp('^https://robot[.]suji[.]work/xiaozhi/otaMag/download/[0-9a-f-]+$', 'i').test(pm.variables.get('otaDownloadUrl') || '')) throw new Error('Run the OTA check first and obtain an update URL.');

if (pm.response.code !== 200 || !(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').startsWith('application/octet-stream') || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(pm.response.headers.get('X-Firmware-SHA256') || '')) throw new Error('Not a valid firmware download response.');

request.description: Use Send and Download for the complete xiaozhi.bin app. Verify the saved file SHA-256 against X-Firmware-SHA256. This app is not the full-flash image for address 0x0.
